mapper.select: SELECT U."userNo", U."userName", UI."userBirth", '접속중' AS "status", -- [거리 계산] DB 이미지의 LATITUDE, LONGITUDE 컬럼 사용 ROUND( 6371 * ACOS( LEAST(1.0, GREATEST(-1.0, COS(MY_LOC."LATITUDE" * 0.0174532925) * COS(YOUR_LOC."LATITUDE" * 0.0174532925) * COS((YOUR_LOC."LONGITUDE" - MY_LOC."LONGITUDE") * 0.0174532925) + SIN(MY_LOC."LATITUDE" * 0.0174532925) * SIN(YOUR_LOC."LATITUDE" * 0.0174532925) )) ), 1 ) AS "distance", ( SELECT LISTAGG(IMG."imageUrl", ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY IMG."imageProfile" DESC, IMG."imageNo") FROM "userImage" IMG WHERE IMG."userNo" = U."userNo" ) AS "images" FROM "users" U JOIN "userInfo" UI ON U."userNo" = UI."userNo" -- [수정] 테이블명 대문자 통일 JOIN "USER_LOCATIONS" YOUR_LOC ON U."userNo" = YOUR_LOC."USERNO" CROSS JOIN ( SELECT "LATITUDE", "LONGITUDE" FROM "USER_LOCATIONS" WHERE "USERNO" = #{userNo} ) MY_LOC WHERE U."userNo" != #{userNo} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM "swipe" S WHERE S."fromUserNo" = #{userNo} AND S."toUserNo" = U."userNo" ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM "userBlock" B WHERE B."fromUserNo" = #{userNo} AND B."toUserNo" = U."userNo" ) -- 거리 필터 AND ( 6371 * ACOS( LEAST(1.0, GREATEST(-1.0, COS(MY_LOC."LATITUDE" * 0.0174532925) * COS(YOUR_LOC."LATITUDE" * 0.0174532925) * COS((YOUR_LOC."LONGITUDE" - MY_LOC."LONGITUDE") * 0.0174532925) + SIN(MY_LOC."LATITUDE" * 0.0174532925) * SIN(YOUR_LOC."LATITUDE" * 0.0174532925) )) ) ) <= #{distanceKm} ORDER BY "distance" ASC
